title: Gamete Treatment to Correct Fertilization Failure
official: Gamete Treatment to Correct Fertilization Failure
summary: In this proposed research study, the investigators plan to assess the efficacy of gametes' (egg and sperm) treatment on fertilization as well as pre- and post-implantation embryo development.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with complete fertilization failure with standard IVF or failure with one prior ICSI treatment cycle

Exclusion Criteria:

* not meeting inclusion criteria
* IVF without ICSI
sponsor: Weill Medical College of Cornell University
